title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - Same staff two browser tabs - Reuse existing active report
description: AC 01.1 / AC 01.2 / AC 01.3 - Race-condition regression - Opening the same lesson in two tabs and submitting Add New Aver Lesson Report twice creates only one active report.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-01 exists and has no active Aver Lesson Report.
- Browser Tab 1 and Tab 2 both open the Lesson Report entry point for LSN-111026-01.
- QA can verify Lesson_Report__c records for the lesson from Salesforce list/API/query.
steps_actions:
1. "In Tab 1, click `Add New Aver Lesson Report`."
2. "Without refreshing Tab 2, click `Add New Aver Lesson Report` in Tab 2 within the same test window."
3. "Save or complete both flows."
4. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-01."
steps_result:
1. "The create flow starts for LSN-111026-01."
2. "The second create request is accepted for processing or resolves to an existing report without an unhandled error."
3. "Both tabs resolve to the same Aver Lesson Report ID."
4. "Exactly one active Lesson_Report__c exists for the lesson."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - Two staff create same lesson report concurrently - Single active report
description: AC 01.1 / AC 01.2 / AC 01.3 - Concurrency - Two staff users creating the same Aver Lesson Report at nearly the same time must not create duplicates.
preconditions:
- HQ Staff A and CM Staff B are logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-02 exists and has no active Aver Lesson Report.
- Both staff can access the lesson report creation entry point.
steps_actions:
1. "Staff A opens LSN-111026-02 and clicks `Add New Aver Lesson Report`."
2. "Staff B clicks `Add New Aver Lesson Report` for the same lesson at nearly the same time."
3. "Complete both create/save flows."
4. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-02."
steps_result:
1. "Staff A starts report creation."
2. "Staff B's request does not create an independent active report."
3. "Both users are linked to the same existing or newly-created report record."
4. "Exactly one active report exists; no second Draft report is created."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - Existing active Draft report - Add action opens existing report
description: AC 02.1 - State transition - When an active Draft report already exists, Add New Aver Lesson Report reuses it instead of creating a duplicate.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-03 has active Draft Aver Lesson Report ALR-111026-DRAFT.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the Lesson Report entry point for LSN-111026-03."
2. "Click `Add New Aver Lesson Report`."
3. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-03."
steps_result:
1. "The page/card recognizes the lesson report context."
2. "The system opens or returns ALR-111026-DRAFT."
3. "Only ALR-111026-DRAFT exists as active; no new report is inserted."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - Existing active Published report - No new Draft report
description: AC 02.2 / AC 03.1 - Regression - Existing Published report must be reused and must not be hidden by a new Draft duplicate.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-04 has active Published Aver Lesson Report ALR-111026-PUBLISHED.
- Lesson List currently displays Published for LSN-111026-04.
steps_actions:
1. "Open LSN-111026-04 and click `Add New Aver Lesson Report`."
2. "Refresh Lesson List and the Lesson Report detail page."
3. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-04."
steps_result:
1. "The system opens or returns ALR-111026-PUBLISHED, or blocks new creation by reusing the active report."
2. "Both surfaces still show the same Published report status."
3. "Exactly one active report exists and no new Draft report is created."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - No active report exists - Creates one active report

preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-05 has no active Aver Lesson Report.
- Any old report for this lesson is inactive/deleted according to the product data model.
steps_actions:
1. "Open LSN-111026-05 and click `Add New Aver Lesson Report`."
2. "Save the report."
3. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-05."
steps_result:
1. "A new Aver Lesson Report creation flow starts."
2. "The report is saved successfully."
3. "Exactly one active report exists for the lesson."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report status - Publish after duplicate-prevention flow - List/card/detail remain consistent
description: AC 03.1 - End-to-end regression - After the duplicate-prevention path, publishing the single report keeps Lesson List, card, and detail status consistent.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-06 has one active Draft Aver Lesson Report created through a duplicate-prevention scenario.
- The report is publishable.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the active Draft report for LSN-111026-06."
2. "Publish the report."
3. "Refresh Lesson List, the Lesson Report card, and Lesson Report detail."
4. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-06."
steps_result:
1. "The Draft report opens with a single report ID."
2. "The report status changes to Published."
3. "All three surfaces resolve to the same report ID and show Published."
4. "Exactly one active report exists."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report data integrity - Details and Student Session remain linked to single report
description: AC 03.2 / AC 03.3 - Data integrity - Duplicate-prevention must not split details or Student Session references across report records.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-07 has students and report details available for Aver Lesson Report creation.
- A concurrent create or rapid retry scenario has just been executed for this lesson.
steps_actions:
1. "Query the active Aver Lesson Report for LSN-111026-07."
2. "Query Lesson_Report_Detail__c records for the lesson/report."
3. "Query Student_Sessions__c.Lesson_Report__c for students in the lesson."
4. "Check for orphan duplicate reports/details."
steps_result:
1. "Exactly one active report ID is returned."
2. "All active detail records reference the single active report ID."
3. "Student Session references point to the same report ID where the product flow expects a lesson report link."
4. "No extra active report and no orphan active detail record exists."

title: [Aver] Lesson Report creation - Rapid double-click/retry - Backend remains idempotent
description: AC 01.1 / AC 03.3 - Negative regression - Rapid repeated user action or duplicate network submission must not create multiple active reports.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce for the Aver tenant.
- Lesson LSN-111026-08 has no active Aver Lesson Report.
- The test can simulate rapid double-click, retry, or duplicate API calls for the same create action.
steps_actions:
1. "Trigger `Add New Aver Lesson Report` twice rapidly for LSN-111026-08."
2. "Wait for both requests to settle."
3. "Query active Aver Lesson Reports for LSN-111026-08."
4. "Refresh the page and click `Add New Aver Lesson Report` again."
steps_result:
1. "The UI may disable the second click, or the backend may receive duplicate requests."
2. "No unhandled error is shown; at most one report ID is returned as active."
3. "Exactly one active report exists for the lesson."
4. "The same existing report opens or is returned."
